Grilled Teriyaki Chicken

About Panda Express Grilled Teriyaki Chicken

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken is the primary lean protein anchor on the Panda Express menu. Prepared on a flat-top grill rather than in a deep fryer, it features boneless chicken thighs sliced into tender strips and served alongside a traditional sweetened soy glaze.

Is Panda Express Grilled Teriyaki Chicken Healthy?

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken is widely considered one of the most macro-friendly items at Panda Express. Delivering 36 grams of protein for only 300 calories, it provides an outstanding protein-to-calorie ratio with zero deep-fry batter. Requesting the sauce on the side allows you to control sugar and sodium consumption directly.

How to Order Grilled Teriyaki Chicken for Less

  • Use active coupon codes like PANDA20 online to save 20% on your entire plate.
  • Order a Bigger Plate if you want leftovers. The extra entree costs about $2, giving you high-protein meal prep for tomorrow.
  • Scan your receipt for the guest survey to earn a free entree code for your next visit.

Expert Ordering & Nutrition Tips

Ask for Sauce on the Side

Request the teriyaki glaze in a small dipping container. Dipping lightly rather than coating the meat reduces added sugars while maintaining rich flavor.

Pair with Super Greens

Combining Grilled Teriyaki Chicken with Super Greens delivers a clean, high-protein meal with 36g of protein and minimal processed carbohydrates.

Check the Grill Freshness

Grilled chicken takes longer to prepare than wok stir-fries. Look at the serving station to ensure you receive a freshly sliced, juicy portion.
